title: Monotonicity of diagonal simulation bounds
statement: Suppose a padded diagonal simulator works with bound function $\Phi$, and let $\Phi' : \mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and $K \in \mathbb{N}$ satisfy $\Phi(t,n) \le K\Phi'(t,n)$ for all natural numbers $t,n$. Then the same simulating machine is a padded diagonal simulator with bound function $\Phi'$.
hypotheses_covered: A padded diagonal simulator with bound function $\Phi$
The pointwise bound $\Phi(t,n) \le K\Phi'(t,n)$ for all $t,n$
